trigger.description: An ee.cursor.v1 continuation cursor is resumed after the workspace DB generation advanced past the cursor's dbGeneration (ADR 0063 §3). Pagination across writes is dishonest — pages must partition exactly one generation's result set with no duplicates and no gaps — so the codec rejects the cursor as stale instead of silently mixing generations. The codec and degraded contract ship with bd-7lvbg.2; per-surface --cursor resume is wired by bd-7lvbg.3. A rejected cursor always yields an EMPTY page plus this degraded entry, never a restarted page, so a page sequence can never duplicate items.

expected_emission.repair_contains: without --cursor to start a fresh page sequence
